new_result.statement: Prepartitioning protected global indices and aligned reference values once by ZeRO rank is algebraically equivalent to the public per-step global-copy-then-filter path for pending global_idx, sign-gradient values, per-rank partial mask-loss contribution, and complete partition coverage, provided the GLOBAL masked-count denominator is preserved.
new_result.tested_scope: source-equivalent CPU algebra only; no DeepSpeed hook/reduce-scatter execution and no PyTorch 2.8 runtime
required_invariants: retain global_n_masked per tensor as a scalar; do not replace it with rank-local support count
retain global_idx for gradient-hook injection because the public hook indexes the full pre-reduce-scatter gradient
prepartition ref values with the same boolean selection/order as global_idx
fail closed or rebuild rank-local state if world_size, rank assignment, ds_numel, or canonical parameter identity changes

naive_local_denominator_counterexample.interpretation: Using local support count is not a transport-only optimization: it changes regularizer semantics and introduces rank-dependent coordinate scale when support is imbalanced. Distributed scaling correction must remain a separate explicit axis.

conditional_qwen4b_steady_state_model.current_aux_bytes_per_rank_formula: N + 12*s (dense bool mask + int64 global indices + fp32 refs)
conditional_qwen4b_steady_state_model.scope: capacity model, not measured RSS; actual support and per-rank imbalance must be profiled
